quotes.confounding: A control group was formed from patients evaluated at each respective trauma center within five years prior to the conclusion of data collection for this report... matched to the “Hospital TXA” group patients through the use of propensity scoring based upon age, gender, injury severity score (ISS), and mechanism of injury.
quotes.selection: Patients who sustained blunt or penetrating trauma with signs of hemorrhagic shock from June 2014 through July 2018 were considered for TXA treatment.
quotes.classification: Identification of study patients receiving TXA was achieved through a wristband labeled “TXA” and/or verbal communication at patient hand-off by team members.
quotes.deviations: TXA was delivered in two doses as per the protocol used in the CRASH-2 trial. The first dose was one gram... followed by a second dose... administered uniformly between centers based on the study protocol.
quotes.missingData: Follow-up to determine mortality outcomes after hospital discharge were abstracted from the EHR and trauma registry. In select cases, we conducted direct chart review and, in cases of missing data, study investigators contacted the patient(s) and/or the families directly... All patients included in this study were accounted for via hospital follow-up or direct communication.
quotes.measurement: Follow-up to determine mortality outcomes after hospital discharge were abstracted from the EHR and trauma registry.
quotes.reporting: Based on the original study design, three pre-specified subgroup analyses were conducted to assess outcomes of patients...
